__Snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/e944881b0[develop@e944881b0], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/1cc142d51..e944881b0[changes since 1cc142d51].__

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * Accounts, address campaigns and license management (Wicket pages removed).
  * Customers: Wicket pages removed; customer and free-text customer merged into one field.
- **Invoices**
  * Cancellation sets the original invoice to __cancelled__; explained on the button and in the form, with a warning not to change the amounts.
  * Choice of the Word template for the ZUGFeRD export; the invoice PDF is rendered with LibreOffice and the installed fonts.
  * Empty e-invoice fields are filled from the account; cancellation invoices are supported by the Word template.
  * Charts show which list filter they applied; state filters are left out of the year comparison.
- Order and invoice forms: customer column, highlighted head, tinted position headers, sibling cost units in the cost assignment pickers.
- Labels, select values, pickers and section titles can be copied.
- Monthly report: the cost type is only shown for customer cost units.
- Change history shows user and group lists by name as removed/added diff.
- Liquidity planning: negative balances highlighted, credit/debit bars in green/red.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Time sheets can no longer be booked on structure elements of an ended or deleted project.
- Saving an invoice no longer shifts the index of its cost assignments.
- Positions of orders, invoices and incoming invoices are sorted by number.
- Order forecast charts and Excel select exactly the orders of the list.
- Word-to-PDF conversion works again (OpenPDF dropped).

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- 2FA required for the migrated system and plugin pages and the liquidity series split.
